description_en: Queries the average statistics of a specified metric in a specified site monitoring task by calling the DescribeSiteMonitorStatistics operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeSiteMonitorStatistics接口查询指定站点监控任务中指定监控项的平均统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-site-monitor-statistics --task-id ef4cdc8b-9dc7-43e7-810e-f950e56c0000 --metric-name Availability --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSiteMonitorStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the site monitoring task.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a site monitoring task, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115052.html
parameters.help_zh:
站点监控任务ID。

关于如何获取站点监控任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115052.html
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The statistical period.


Unit: minutes. Default value: 1440 (1 day). Maximum value: 43200 (30 days)
parameters.help_zh:
统计周期。


单位：分钟。默认值：1440（1天）。最大值：43200（30天）
parameters.name: time_range

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Unit: milliseconds. Default value: 1 hour before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒。默认值为当前时间向前推1小时
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metric. Valid values:

Availability: the availability.
ErrorRate: the error rate.
ResponseTime: the response time
parameters.help_zh:
监控项名称。取值：

Availability：可用率。
ErrorRate：错误率。
ResponseTime：响应时间
parameters.name: metric_name

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.
The value 200 indicates that the call is successful

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
